title: When bias backfires: the modulatory role of counterfactual explanations on the adoption of algorithmic bias in XAI-supported human decision-making
core_idea: A controlled experiment uses a simulated hiring task with baseline, biased-AI, and post-interaction phases to investigate how biased AI recommendations, presented with or without counterfactual explanations, influence human decision-making over time and whether explanations modulate adoption of algorithmic bias.
tldr: The study examines whether and how counterfactual explanations change the extent to which people adopt biased AI recommendations in a simulated hiring task across sequential interaction phases.
